# 50agents

> 50agents is a product from viaSocket. You tell Captain, its AI, what you need in plain words, and it builds automations, AI agents, browser agents and apps that do the work in your real apps, with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits.

## Links

- [Home](https://50agents.com/): what 50agents is and how it works.
- [Sign up](https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login): create a free workspace, or sign in.
- [Full context (llms-full.txt)](https://50agents.com/llms-full.txt): entire public site guide in one file.
- [NLWeb /ask](https://50agents.com/ask): natural-language query over public content.

## For AI agents

- [AI catalog](https://50agents.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): every machine-readable resource on this site.
- [Agent skills](https://50agents.com/.well-known/agent-skills.json): what an agent can do here today.
- [Home in markdown](https://50agents.com/index.md) and [pricing in markdown](https://50agents.com/pricing.md).
- Open Captain with a job already typed: https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login?draft=<the job, URL-encoded>. The person signs in and taps Build it.
- [Sitemap index](https://50agents.com/sitemap.xml): every indexed page, one sitemap per family.
